title: FLA import: Scene 5 mask drops 'Ball' masked child (mask before child in bottom-to-top binary)
description:
REPRO (Magnet.fla / fixtures/Magnet.fla, scene play order = Contents order: Scene 2, Scene 5, AA, BA, AB, BB; Scene 5 = OLE2 stream 'Page 5').

Ground truth (raw parse of Page 5 via parseFla8Timeline, bottom-to-top binary order):
  [bin 0] 'Layer 3'  type=0 normal  (hidden,locked)
  [bin 1] 'Ball'     type=0 normal  parentLayerRef peek=0x8003(32771)
  [bin 2] 'Layer 5'  type=4 MASK    (hidden,locked)
  [bin 3] 'Layer 5'  type=0 normal  parentLayerRef peek=17
The 'Layer 5' MASK should clip TWO masked children: the masked 'Layer 5' (bin 3, holds Symbol 6 + script 'Stage.showMenu=false;') AND 'Ball' (bin 1, holds Symbol 2 + Symbol 9 + static text). [User-confirmed against real Flash 8.]

OBSERVED (our import, doc.scenes[1], top-to-bottom li after reverse):
  li=0 'Layer 5' type=mask
  li=1 'Layer 5' type=masked
  li=2 'Ball'    type=NORMAL   <-- WRONG, should be 'masked'
  li=3 'Layer 3' type=normal
So the mask clips only ONE child ('Layer 5'); 'Ball' is dropped from the mask group and renders un-masked. Contrast scene AA (Page 1) where the SAME-named 'Layer 5' mask correctly clips Magnets/Walls/Ball and the existing magnet-inspect.test.ts only checks AA, so this regression is untested.

ROOT CAUSE:
1) packages/core/src/fla/flash8-import.ts:1403-1437 resolveMaskedLayers(): the scan walks the bottom-to-top binary list and sets inMaskGroup=true ONLY when it ENCOUNTERS a type=4 mask layer, then promotes ONLY subsequent layers (forward). It can never promote a masked child that appears BEFORE the mask in binary order. In AA all three children sit AFTER the mask (binIdx 3,4,5 > mask binIdx 2) so it works; in Scene 5 'Ball' (binIdx 1) sits BEFORE the mask (binIdx 2) and is silently skipped.
2) packages/core/src/fla/flash8-binary.ts:1305-1308: parentLayerRef is a raw 2-byte little-endian PEEK of the CPicLayer trailer (r.buf[r.pos] | r.buf[r.pos+1]<<8) — the comment itself calls it un-decoded/heuristic. For Ball it reads 0x8003 (the 0x8000 CArchive backref-tag bit is SET => this is a class backref tag, NOT a layer index); the masked 'Layer 5' reads 17. In AA all three children coincidentally read a clean, consistent 18, which is why the group-by-equal-ref heuristic happens to work there. The peek is landing on different trailer bytes for different layers.

FIX DIRECTION (described, NOT applied):
- Decode parentLayerRef PROPERLY from the CPicLayer trailer instead of a fixed 2-byte peek, so every masked child yields a stable index pointing at its mask's CArchive object id (resolve the 0x8000-tagged backref form vs the raw-index form to the same canonical mask object). Then group masked children by 'parentLayerRef == that mask's object id' regardless of whether the child is before or after the mask in binary order.
- Make resolveMaskedLayers two-pass / order-independent: first identify each mask layer and its CArchive object id, then promote ANY layer (before OR after) whose parentLayerRef resolves to that mask. Drop the 'consecutive run after the mask' assumption.
- The post-reversal reorder block (flash8-import.ts:1473-1500) that re-inserts a run of 'masked' layers after their 'mask' must also handle masked children that were originally before the mask; verify the model invariant (mask at li=k, masked children at li=k+1..) holds for [mask, Layer5-masked, Ball].
- Add an order-independent fixture assertion for Scene 5 (Page 5): mask 'Layer 5' clips BOTH 'Layer 5'(masked) and 'Ball'. Existing magnet-inspect.test.ts only covers AA.

NO PRODUCT CODE CHANGED in this QA pass (report+root-cause only). Repro probe: parseFla8Timeline(streams.get('Page 5')) shows raw layerType/parentLayerRef; tryLoadRealFla(Magnet.fla).scenes[1] shows the dropped masked child. HEAD d678884.
